unlisted.quote: The error message is on screen before anyone has typed, and it is not tied to the field
unlisted.reason: Static error messages shown at load with no aria-invalid/describedby/role=alert is a genuine defect beyond the wording issues.

unlisted.quote: The section is a `<section>`, not a `<form>`, so pressing Enter in the field does nothing.
unlisted.reason: Newsletter field not wrapped in a form is a real usability defect.

unlisted.quote: The banner's close button does nothing and has no name
unlisted.reason: Close button not wired to dismiss the banner is a real functional defect.

unlisted.quote: Hero lede (line 22, `#dcd0ff` over the gradient) measures 4.04:1 at the purple end
unlisted.reason: Additional low contrast on hero lede over the gradient.

unlisted.quote: The "Most popular tier" pill (line 78) sits on the cheapest plan only
unlisted.reason: Misleading badge on the cheapest plan is a genuine content issue.
Empty placeholder in the hero that looks like a failed image.

unlisted.quote: The hero has no button at all
unlisted.reason: No primary action on the first screen is a genuine issue.

unlisted.quote: Plan buttons are 35 px tall (below the 44 px touch size)
unlisted.reason: Small touch targets on the main CTAs.

unlisted.quote: The input is 36 px tall and the button 42 px, so they do not line up
unlisted.reason: Control height mismatch is a real polish defect.

unlisted.quote: A destructive confirmation sits in the middle of the pricing page
unlisted.reason: Inline non-modal dialog not focus-managed on a pricing page is a real issue.
Table lacks caption and header scope.

unlisted.quote: The footer links all go to `href="#"`
unlisted.reason: Dead links are a genuine defect.
Weak headline that omits the product name and mis-capitalises.

unlisted.quote: The "What you get" icon row is made of emoji and breaks at phone width
unlisted.reason: Wrapping orphan at phone width is a layout defect beyond the emoji-as-icons point.
Pill badges and outlined cards are lint house style, not a user-facing defect.
